title: First-principles investigation of structural, elastic, electronic, thermodynamic, and optical properties of KBi3 for optoelectronic applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,49165-49177
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07125A, Paper

This work demonstrates that KBi3 is a mechanically ductile metallic compound exhibiting high infrared reflectivity and strong visible-UV absorption, highlighting its suitability for multifunctional optoelectronic technologies.
